profile.description: Southern Province Cement Company manufactures and produces cement, derivatives, and accessories in Saudi Arabia. It offers cement for walls and floors, ordinary Portland cement, sulfate-resistant cement, and Portland pozzolanic cement, as well as clinkers. The company was founded in 1978 and is based in Abha, Saudi Arabia.
